**Recommendation for Andre Williams**  

Last quarter, Andre spearheaded a Unreal Engine 4 project to rebuild Lumina’s flagship multiplayer shooter. Despite a 40-person team and tight deadlines, he optimized server sync latency by 35% using custom networking code, slashing client-reported lag during peak hours. His ability to balance high-level design with low-level optimization made the title a critical hit.  

We’ve collaborated daily for over two years, debugging engine issues and refining gameplay systems. Andre’s work ethic is unshakable—he’ll stay late to tweak particle effects or refactor legacy code, never shying from messy technical debt.  

His Unreal expertise is second to none. He architected a scalable physics system for a VR title, reducing CPU overhead by 22% through custom collision culling. He also led a React-based dashboard for real-time analytics, streamlining cross-team debugging. Game networking is his niche—his peer-reviewed codebase for a 500-player battle royale became a internal best practice.  

Andre’s a reliable, collaborative force. He mentors juniors without micromanaging, and his curiosity drives continuous improvement.  

—Jen Martinez, Senior Engine Architect, FAANG
